headlines.title: China’s debt ratio dips as households cut borrowing and firms slash investment: report
headlines.summary:
China’s debt-to-GDP ratio fell in the second quarter for the first time since 2022, even as the government kept borrowing while households and private companies pulled back under the weight of falling home prices, sluggish income growth and shrinking profit margins, according to a new report.

headlines.title_en: Colombian Peso Hits Seven-Year High; Central Bank to Accumulate FX Reserves to Guide Exchange Rate Lower
headlines.summary_en: Colombia launched a program aimed at accumulating up to $4 billion in international reserves to pull its currency back from a seven-year high. On July 31, central bank Governor Leonardo Villar announced the decision, just after policymakers held interest rates steady. The program will begin in early August via monthly put option auctions, with the first auction capped at $400 million.

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Commerce Responds to U.S. Adding Chinese Companies to So-Called Xinjiang Act Entity List
headlines.summary_en: Q: On July 31 EST, the U.S. Department of Homeland Security added over 40 Chinese entities to the Uyghur Forced Labor Prevention Act entity list. What is China's comment? A: We have noted the situation. The U.S. actions are entirely unfounded, and its continued use of so-called 'human rights' and 'forced labor' pretexts to unilaterally sanction Chinese enterprises under domestic law is a typical act of economic coercion. These measures severely harm the legitimate rights of affected companies and disrupt the stability of global industrial and supply chains.

headlines.title_en: CCC Certification for EV Charging Piles Becomes Mandatory from August 1
headlines.summary_en: From August 1, the State Administration for Market Regulation (CNCA) will mandatorily enforce CCC certification management for electric vehicle power supply equipment, conducting tests on key safety indicators such as electric shock protection, short-circuit protection, and fire/heat resistance, along with on-site inspections of manufacturing quality assurance capability and product consistency to firmly safeguard product quality and safety standards. As new energy vehicles become increasingly widespread, EV power supply equipment (commonly known as charging piles) has become vital infrastructure for public travel. Starting August 1, EV power supply equipment without CCC certification may not be shipped, sold, imported, or used in other business operations. For equipment already in operation before August 1, operators must strictly comply with the Product Quality Law and Consumer Rights Protection Law to ensure the goods or services they provide meet regulations.

headlines.summary: 周五（7月31日）纽约尾盘，美国10年期基准国债收益率涨6.15个基点，报4.7347%，本周累计上涨5.76个基点，7月份累计上涨25.56个基点，整体持续震荡上行，交投于4.4534%-4.7450%区间，北京时间8月1日01:47逼近2025年1月14日顶部4.8069%、2023年10月23日顶部5.0187%。 两年期美债收益率涨4.53个基点，报4.2912%，临近结束交易时短线从4.26%附近拉升至4.29%上方，本周累跌3.94个基点、绝大部分时间处于下跌状态，7月份累涨11.68个基点，交投于4.1018%-4.3683%区间。

headlines.title_en: U.S. 10-Year Treasury Yield Hits Highest Since January Last Year, Up Over 25 Basis Points in July
headlines.summary_en: Friday (July 31) New York close: U.S. 10-year Treasury yield rose 6.15 basis points to 4.7347%, up 5.76 bps on the week and up 25.56 bps in July, continuing a choppy upward trend, trading in a 4.4534%-4.7450% range, approaching the January 14, 2025 high of 4.8069% and the October 23, 2023 high of 5.0187% around 01:47 Beijing time August 1. Two-year Treasury yield rose 4.53 bps to 4.2912%, briefly climbing from around 4.26% to above 4.29% near session end, down 3.94 bps on the week and mostly declining, up 11.68 bps in July, trading in a 4.1018%-4.3683% range.

headlines.title: 巴新外长重申坚定奉行一个中国政策
headlines.summary: 金十数据8月1日讯，巴布亚新几内亚外交部长特卡琴科7月31日重申，巴新政府坚定奉行一个中国政策，愿以建交50周年为契机，推动两国各领域交流合作取得更多成果。特卡琴科当天在莫尔兹比港参加岭南文化南太行（巴新）活动启动仪式时致辞并作出上述表示。他同时感谢中方对巴新文化和教育事业发展的长期支持。巴新首都区行政长官帕克普也出席了仪式。

headlines.title_en: Papua New Guinea's foreign minister reaffirms firm commitment to the One-China policy
headlines.summary_en: Jin10 Data, August 1 - Papua New Guinea's Foreign Minister Tkatchenko reaffirmed on July 31 that the PNG government firmly adheres to the One-China policy and is willing to take the 50th anniversary of diplomatic relations as an opportunity to promote more achievements in exchanges and cooperation across various fields. Tkatchenko made these remarks during his speech at the launch ceremony of the Lingnan Culture South Taihang (PNG) event in Port Moresby that day. He also thanked China for its long-term support for PNG's cultural and educational development. Parkop, the governor of the National Capital District of PNG, also attended the ceremony.

headlines.title: 深圳住宅7月网签8324套，同比增长13.8%
headlines.summary: 据深视新闻，7月以来，深圳楼市延续上半年活跃态势，当月全市新建商品住宅和二手住宅累计网签8324套，同比增长13.8%。7月，深圳全市新建商品住宅网签销售3529套，同比增长32.7%。今年以来“好房子”项目持续热销，开盘当日平均去化率在七成左右，市场热度较高。7月，深圳全市二手住宅网签销售4795套，同比增长3%，约占商品住宅成交总量六成。

headlines.title_en: Shenzhen residential property online registrations reached 8,324 units in July, up 13.8% year-on-year
headlines.summary_en: According to Shenzhen TV News, since July, the Shenzhen property market has continued the active trend from the first half of the year, with a total of 8,324 new and second-hand residential units registered online for the month, up 13.8% year-on-year. In July, 3,529 new residential units were registered and sold online in Shenzhen, up 32.7% year-on-year. Since the beginning of this year, 'good housing' projects have remained popular, with an average sell-through rate of around 70% on launch day, indicating high market enthusiasm. In July, 4,795 second-hand residential units were registered and sold online in Shenzhen, up 3% year-on-year, accounting for about 60% of total residential transactions.

headlines.title: 干旱导致缺电，罗马尼亚全国整个8月进入警戒状态
headlines.summary: 当地时间7月31日，罗马尼亚政府宣布，受近期干旱和河流流量下降影响，罗马尼亚发电量下降，在整个8月期间全国进入警戒状态。罗马尼亚国内燃气、燃煤发电厂将以最大产能运行，同时投入光伏、风力发电和储能，并从有过剩产能国家进口电力，以缓解当前局面。（央视新闻）

headlines.title_en: Drought Causes Power Shortage; Romania on Alert Throughout August
headlines.summary_en: On July 31 local time, the Romanian government announced that due to recent drought and falling river flows, power generation has declined, prompting a nationwide alert for the entire month of August. Domestic gas and coal-fired plants will operate at maximum capacity, while solar, wind, and storage capacity will be deployed, and electricity will be imported from countries with surplus capacity to ease the situation. (CCTV)
